title: pfaffia holosericea
intro: Pfaffia holosericea, commonly known as Suma, is a perennial plant native to the tropical regions of South America, particularly in Brazil. Suma is a rich source of nutrients, offering various health benefits such as improving digestion, boosting the immune system, and acting as an anti-inflammatory agent. The therapeutic actions of Suma include its ability to act as an adaptogen, antioxidant, and vasodilator, which help in reducing stress, promoting cardiovascular health, and enhancing overall well-being. The bioactive constituents of Suma include isoflavones, flavonoids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties and potential health benefits.
